title: Cardinal Billing Account Assisted Payment: Settled Balance and Payment Amount
content:
**Computation clause.** An assisted payment on a Cardinal Billing Account is a one-time payment that the named insured authorizes from their own card or bank account while a representative is on the line, to settle the whole balance of the billing account. The assisted payment is the settled balance plus the pay plan's phone representative payment fee. The settled balance is every installment invoiced, fee charged, returned payment, additional-premium bill and refund posted on the account, less every payment, credit, fee waiver and write-off posted on it. The representative payment fee is rounded to the cent once, as its final figure, no intermediate figure being rounded, and the assisted payment amount is the settled balance plus that fee, rounded to the cent. No fee is charged when the payment cures a notice of cancellation (an account in notice pending status) or reinstates the account (an account cancelled for nonpayment).

## The settled balance

| Added | Subtracted |
|---|---|
| Installments invoiced | Payments |
| Fees charged | Credits |
| Returned payments | Fee waivers |
| Additional-premium bills | Write-offs |
| Refunds | |

Every entry of these kinds posted on the account counts, whatever its date.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

1. An account shows installments invoiced of $960.00, fees charged of $40.00, one returned payment of $160.00 and payments of $780.00. The settled balance is $960.00 plus $40.00 plus $160.00, less $780.00, that is $380.00.
2. On a plan whose phone representative payment fee is $5.00, the assisted payment amount is $380.00 plus $5.00, that is $385.00, with a fee of $5.00.
3. The same account in notice pending status: the fee is $0.00 and the assisted payment amount is $380.00.
